Author: Jakub Olek
Name: System Monitor
Description: The Mac's CPU, memory, disk and network activity with live graphs. Press to open Activity Monitor.

Actions.Name: System
Actions.Tooltip: CPU, memory, disk and network on one key. Press to open Activity Monitor.

Actions.Name: CPU
Actions.Tooltip: CPU use across all cores, with a two-minute graph. Press to open Activity Monitor.

Actions.Name: Memory
Actions.Tooltip: Memory used, coloured by memory pressure, with a two-minute graph. Press to open Activity Monitor.

Actions.Name: Disk
Actions.Tooltip: Disk writes and reads per second, with a two-minute graph. Press to open Activity Monitor.

Actions.Name: Network
Actions.Tooltip: Network download and upload per second, with a two-minute graph. Press to open Activity Monitor.
